resources.string: Select a camera source, then enable Walking Aid. Stop Walking Aid before changing sources. Live video runs YOLO locally on the latest frame; the photo interval applies only to periodic photos.
Connect your glasses, register CyanBridge, and authorize the camera in Meta setup. Then return here and enable Walking Aid.
Nearby Wi-Fi devices (or Location on older Android versions) is required to receive EyeVue live video.
Nearby devices permission is required to connect to the glasses camera.
Allow the requested permission to use Walking Aid with your glasses.
